canonical_metrics.business_rule: Sums approved principal across active non-superseded applications only; excludes superseded intake deferrals and declined underwriting.
Sums settled application processing and origination fees minus reversed/refunded fee entries.

canonical_metrics.sql_expression: SUM(ad_spend_cad) / SUM(CASE WHEN is_funded_loan THEN position_based_weight ELSE 0 END)
canonical_metrics.business_rule: Allocates 40% credit to first touch, 40% to last pre-signup touch, and 20% to middle touches across deduplicated click IDs.

canonical_metrics.sql_expression: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_funded THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT applicant_id)
canonical_metrics.business_rule: Measured on canonical root applicants assigned to their active post-deferral intake cohort.
